description: This file defines an Android Service called RemoteService which demonstrates inter-process communication (IPC) via AIDL interfaces. It includes implementation of service lifecycle methods, callback registration, notification handling, and inner classes for activity-based control and binding to the service.

classes.name: RemoteService
classes.description: An Android Service demonstrating inter-process communication via AIDL, callback registration, notification, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: RemoteService.Controller
classes.description: An inner activity class providing UI for starting and stopping the RemoteService.

classes.name: RemoteService.Binding
classes.description: An inner activity class demonstrating binding and unbinding to the remote service, interacting through AIDL interfaces, and handling callbacks.

classes.name: RemoteService.BindingOptions
classes.description: An inner activity class demonstrating binding with different options and flags.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notification, and starts the value increment handler.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands to the service, logs start intent.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up notification, unregisters callbacks, and stops the handler loop.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns appropriate binder interface based on intent action.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a persistent notification indicating the service is running.
